description.value:
Situated just footsteps from both Coconuts and Plantation surf breaks is Coconut Surf Inn guesthouse. This undiscovered gem is a peaceful, serene oasis that is tucked away from the busy Galle - Matara road, but it right next to the beach.

The space
Coconut Surf Inn is the Eranga family home, so staying here means you will experience the endless warm smiles and kind hospitality of the gracious host Chintaka and his family.

Next to the guesthouse is a large open grassed area overlooking the beach, where the friendly locals and tourists alike gather to watch the surf, play cricket, socialise and enjoy beautiful sunrises and sunsets. You can truly immerse yourself in the life of a small Sri Lankan village.

Coconuts is a consistent A-frame reef break, located in front of the guesthouse. Plantations is a more mellow wave, located just 100 meters walk up the beach. This really is a surfer's paradise.

This isn't just a place to stay, it's a place to live. Enjoy beautiful Midigama from this charming guesthouse right by the beach.

Guest access
There are 09 rooms, with each having a double bed, ceiling fan , Wall fan and own bathroom. Sheets and towels are provided. Hammocks, a shady restaurant area and garden, outdoor shower, clothes line and surf board rack are all provided. All meals, snacks and drinks available.(Break fast not included to the Price)

description_booking.value:
Facing the seafront in Weligama, Coconut Surf Inn has a garden and a shared lounge. Among the facilities of this property are a restaurant, a 24-hour front desk and full-day security, along with free WiFi. Boasting family rooms, this property also provides guests with a sun terrace.

The guest house offers some units that feature a balcony and garden view, and units are equipped with a private bathroom and a desk.

As an added convenience, the guest house offers packed lunches for guests to bring on excursions and other trips off-property.

The guest house boasts a variety of wellness options, including spa facilities, a public bath and yoga classes. The area is popular for cycling, and bike hire and car hire are available at Coconut Surf Inn.

Koggala Airport is 11 km from the property, and the property offers a paid airport shuttle service.

The Coconut Surf Inn is extremely basic and unfortunately not recommendable at this price point. The bathroom was very minimal and somewhat run-down; the shower had no temperature control and there was no air conditioning. Unfortunately, there were no photos of the bathroom shown during the booking process, which we found misleading.

The rooms are located directly under the roof and are open between the windows and the top, offering no sound insulation at all. While this might not be an issue in theory, in reality it made sleeping impossible: dogs from the neighborhood were barking throughout the night, and a rooster right next to the property started crowing from around 5 a.m. Even with earplugs, we were unable to sleep.

Additionally, there were loud noises from animals moving inside the walls or ceiling at night, which was very disturbing.

We had booked four nights at the end of our trip and are leaving completely exhausted. For the price paid, we have stayed in significantly better accommodations elsewhere. Although the staff were kind, the overall conditions were a clear downgrade for us.
quotes.title: Basic accommodation with serious comfort and noise issues

These details are listed under the room facilities on Booking.com for each room type, and our other rooms do include that mentioned amenities.

That said, we understand that comfort and good rest are very important, and we’re sorry that noise and other factors affected your sleep. Your feedback is important to us, and we will take it on board as we continue improving both our property and how we communicate room details to guests.

Thank you again for staying with us and for sharing your honest experience.

Loved this place so much! I stayed longer than planned, and will definitly come back to Coconut Surf Inn. 

Peefect location in a quiet and relaxed village with two surfspots, and close to several spots for every surf-level. My room(s) was spacious, comfortable and clean, and the building is well maintained. Rooms are cleaned regularly, and on demand if needed. Beautiful up-stairs restaurant with a huge breakfast selection, varied menu and plenty of chill-out options (hammocks, sofas etc), and an amazing roof-top for surfchecks, relaxing and yoga. 

The building has several areas with hammocks and sofas, good storage for surfboards, and the closeby beach shacks are perfect for watching the sunsets surfers. As a woman travelling alone I felt very safe. 

There is such a warm, friendly and welcoming wibe in this place. A perfect place to surf, relax and rest.The village is a hidden gem, and offers several secrets beaches, massage options, good foods, varied yoga and quiet nights (no noisy parties around) in green and lush surroundings. Tuktuks are available for good priced just outside the inn if you want to explore Weligama Ahangama or other surf spots. 

I highly recommend staying here - good value for money and good wibes.

quotes.text:
Our stay at the Coconut Surf Inn was simply amazing and definitely worth more than nine stars! We were particularly impressed by the varied breakfast, freshly prepared every morning. You could order à la carte and choose from a wide range of options, including lots of fresh fruit. The highlight: the stunning view from the restaurant on the second floor. Watching the waves and the sea while having breakfast was the perfect way to start the day!

The restaurant is lovingly run by a local family who won us over with their warmth and dedication. The rest of the staff was equally helpful and supported us in every way. They even helped us organize affordable tuk-tuks to Weligama or Mirissa – a fantastic service!

The rooms vary in quality. Some have recently been renovated and offer a modern, high-standard experience. Others are still a bit older and might feel slightly musty. If needed, you can simply ask the management about changing rooms – they are very accommodating and willing to help.

There’s plenty to explore in the area as well. The nearby beach bar is a great spot to relax in the evening with a cold beer or a fresh coconut. If you prefer staying in, the in-house restaurant serves delicious meals at very reasonable prices in a pleasant atmosphere.

Our verdict: The Coconut Surf Inn is a fantastic place to stay, with a family-like atmosphere, outstanding breakfast, and unbeatable service. We’ll definitely be back!

quotes.negative_text:
Das war definitiv die schlechteste Preis-Leistung hier auf Sri Lanka. Das Zimmer ist winzig, und die Privatsphäre null. Die Türen haben daumengrosse Spalten und sind nicht etwas doppelt verglast sondern wirklich dünn. Auf beiden Seiten des Zimmers laufen Menschen neben deiner Türe durch und man hört alles. Vorhänge sind so dünn dass man sogar mitbekommt was draussen abgeht und schützen nicht vor Licht. Zudem starten die TucTuc in der Strasse von Hotel und lassen die Motoren aufheulen ab 6:45. 
die Rezeption ist immer leer wenn man etwas braucht, ausserdem haben sie kein Kartenlesegerät und finden es auch nicht relevant das irgendwie zu erwähnen, so dass man dann 80‘000 vom Bankomat abheben darf, welche 15min mit dem TucTuc entfernt ist was noch mal 3000.- kostet. 
Das schlimmste war n aber die Mücken, es gab kein Mückennetz und da überall grosse Ritzen sind kommen ca. 20-30 Mücken in dein Zimmer. Keine Chance das zu verhindern. 
Das Essen im Restaurant oben ist okay, aber wir haben 1,5 Stunden gewartet und das Personal schien komplett überfordert. Was 3 Leute dort machen könnte man mit einer fähigen Person ersetzen. Ebenfalls dort kein Kartenzahlung….
Der Coconut Beach ist leider ziemlich der am wenigsten schöne Strand im Süden, man kann eigentlich nicht ins Wasser wegen den Felsen.
quotes.title: Das schlechteste Preis Leistung bisher auf Sri Lanka

quotes.text: Chintaka’s place is great—though it’s not right on the beach, it’s close enough that you can hear the waves crashing on Coconuts Surf Break making it the perfect place to fall asleep at night or take a siesta during the day. Rooms are basic, but extremely clean and comfortable. They will provide you with drinking water, a towel, soap, and toilet paper during your stay, as well as regular thorough cleaning of your room. Breakfast isn’t included, but you can pay only 500 extra each morning to fill up after a surf, and I have to say their breakfast is the best! Omelette, roti, coconut pancakes, fruit, coffee/tea all made fresh 😋 Chintaka’s family is friendly and helpful, and I will definitely stay here again the next time I’m in Midigama!

quotes.text: Really enjoyed stay at Chinthaka’s place because of its location, right next to the beach. Food wasnt included, but both breakfast and lunch were spectacular, really tasty and good value for money. Very kind people.

quotes.text: With incredible hospitality, local knowledge, and unmatched location for the price, I really think the Coconut Surf Inn is the best value to be found! The rooms are simple and kept clean - all we look for in a stay. They also have a modest but delicious cafe (as do many guest houses) serving breakfast and rice and curry buffet lunch. It stands apart from the others, however, because it is on the second floor where you can catch a nice breeze... essential in the heat of season! It was my husbands favorite breakfast around. And finally, Chinthaka really went above and beyond the call of duty where hospitality was concerned and we are very grateful for the authentic experience. If you’ve already identified the price range you’re looking for, staying here is kind of a no brainer. Happy travels!

Seconds walk to the beach and surf, and a really great neighbourhood of people and restaurants. Eating breakfast here is a treat, you can see the water from the tables. Great food. quotes.text:
This lovely place offers a true local family experience. 
Chatwana, his two brothers, their wives and his parents are all involved in the business of making their guests feel welcome and comfortable. They were always ready for a chat and quick to offer help with anything we needed. 
The area is quiet (big bonus to be off the main road) and the place is only 50m from a small beach. We hired the family's scooter which was great for getting to other surf spots and restaurants. The rooms are quite basic with only cold water and BYO mosquito coils but they're all you need from a beach bungalow. 
We had two dinners and a breakfast which were all delicious, generous and very reasonably priced. 
If you want local, friendly and inexpensive then this place is perfect.

quotes.text:
We stayed in the Coconut Surf Inn for one night. The daughter cooked us an amazing dinner and breakfast (extra charge but not too expensive) and we had it on their rooftop with a view over the ocean. 
There is a bus stop within 1 minute walk from the guesthouse, from there it's only 5 minutes to Weligama Beach and 15 to Mirissa. 
The place is run by a man and his sons, right now they are expanding their building. All really helpful and friendly! 
The room was clean and basic although a bit dark and small but totally alright for the price.
quotes.author: Thies

quotes.text: The staying was nice and pleasant. Host was very communicative, friendly and making sure we are comfortable. We had to change plans last moment and stay shorter time - he agreed to this, which was very kind of him. The standard of room and bathroom is rather basic, but close distance to the beach and cool terrace on roof.

quotes.text: I say thank you! Such a great host family. The neighbourhood was like one family, friendly and helpful.
